streamline-pilot.tagline: A glidey, straight throwing putter. The catch: plastic choice swings it from stable to flippy.

axiom-proxy.tagline: A dead-straight, beadless throwing putter. The catch: stability varies by run and plastic.

kastaplast-jarn.tagline: An overstable approach putter with a hard dump. The catch: K1 and K3 fly like different discs.

prodigy-pa-5.tagline: A shallow, understable throwing putter for turnovers. The catch: fast flat throws nearly roll.

mvp-uplink.tagline: A very understable midrange for hyzer flips and turnovers. The catch: flat releases turn over fast.

no.title: Hand feel
no.t: Splits opinion: the ==thin, soft rim== suits some grips and not others.

innova-fox.tagline: A glidey, understable midrange for flip-ups and turnovers. The catch: power turns it hard right.

dynamic-discs-justice.tagline: A beefy overstable utility midrange for wind and flex shots. The catch: little glide, so it flies short.

westside-anvil.tagline: A beefy, beadless overstable approach midrange. The catch: little glide, so it dumps hard and early.

dynamic-discs-deputy.tagline: A shallow, understable putter for straight putts and turnovers. The catch: power or headwinds flip it.
dynamic-discs-deputy.bottom: Great for newer players and touch turnover shots. Skip it if you putt into headwinds a lot.

yes.title: Easy hyzer flips

yes.title: Reliable hook
yes.t: Pushes briefly, then ==finishes with a sharp, dependable fade==.

innova-aviar.tagline: A classic beadless, straight-flying putter. The catch: the deep rim feels bulky in a lot of hands.

yes.t: Goes ==straight for about 300 ft== before a dependable fade.

yes.title: Tight-course control
yes.t: Keeps ==low-ceiling and forced flex shots== on track.

no.title: Little float
no.t: Flat copies ==lack glide and stall early==, around 380 ft max.

no.title: Beefier than rated
no.t: Aura and Ethereal runs ==fly far more stable than -1.5 turn==.

innova-cro.tagline: A small, flat-flying 5-speed with a cult following. The catch: runs and plastics vary a lot.
innova-cro.bottom: A predictable straight mid if you find a good run. Skip it if you want every copy to fly the same.

yes.title: Predictable flight
yes.t: Flies ==super flat on a dependable line==, even in DX.

yes.title: Comfortable rim
yes.t: Feels ==good in hand== and sits nicer than some rivals.

yes.title: Beats a Roc
yes.t: Outflies ==a classic Innova mid of similar speed== for some throwers.

no.title: Inconsistent runs
no.t: Newer and R-Pro copies ==feel and fly unlike early Star ones==.

no.title: Seasons quickly
no.t: Tree hits and R-Pro wear ==strip its high-speed stability==.

innova-firestorm.tagline: A 14-speed Champion bomber that fights wind. The catch: runs vary from overstable to flippy.
innova-firestorm.bottom: A wind and distance driver for big arms who will sort through copies. Skip it if you throw under 75 mph.

yes.title: Big distance
yes.t: Seasoned or good-run copies ==bomb farther than anything else== in the bag.

yes.title: Wind fighter
yes.t: Handles ==headwinds and big skip shots== off the tee.

no.title: Inconsistent runs
no.t: One new copy dumped and rolled at 200 ft; ==another run was more overstable==.

no.title: Power hungry
no.t: Full distance takes ==75+ mph or very hard throws==, harder on the arm.

no.title: Flips when seasoned
no.t: Beaten-in Champion ==turns remarkably understable== with too much turn.

innova-wahoo.tagline: An R-Pro 12-speed with easy flip and float. The catch: it turns over hard on small errors.
innova-wahoo.bottom: An easy flip-and-float bomber for clean releases. Skip it if you want one that forgives off angles.

yes.title: Easy distance
yes.t: Reached ==415 ft on a nearly straight line== for one thrower.

yes.title: Flips to flat
yes.t: Stands ==up quickly from a slight hyzer== and drifts.

no.title: Overturns readily
no.t: Minor release errors and wear ==roll it over hard==.

no.title: Odd in hand
no.t: The wide rim and R-Pro ==feel strange and stiff== to some throwers.
